scripts.check: npm run check:landscape && npm run check:portrait
scripts.check:landscape: npx --yes hyperframes@0.5.7 lint && npx --yes hyperframes@0.5.7 validate && npx --yes hyperframes@0.5.7 inspect --samples 15
scripts.render: npm run render:landscape && npm run render:portrait
scripts.render:draft: npm run render:landscape:draft && npm run render:portrait:draft
scripts.render:portrait: npx --yes hyperframes@0.5.7 render --composition variants/portrait.html --output renders/grantpipe-explainer-portrait.mp4 --quality standard --fps 30
